cues.text: First, look from above. Does the arch curve like a U, or pinch in toward the front?

delivery.direction: Open warmly and pivot fast on “behind.” Give the three checks different emphasis. Let the last distinction sound like the payoff. Say Mogging dot com.

cues.text: Then look where the back teeth meet. If the uppers sit inside the lowers, that’s a crossbite.

delivery.direction: Open warmly and pivot fast on “behind.” Give the three checks different emphasis. Let the last distinction sound like the payoff. Say Mogging dot com.

visuals.reason: Rotate to a side occlusion view of both arches. Settle counter 2. In the crossbite state, mark the upper and lower contacts with separate white and charcoal leaders.

cues.text: And if the front teeth overlap, you’re seeing a space problem. The arch is only one clue.
